tools.loudnessDescription: Match audio loudness, RMS, or peak level without overwriting the source.
tools.loudnessHint: Analyze each input and write a new file with the _loudness suffix.
tools.loudnessHintitu_bs1770_3: Integrated loudness is measured per ITU-R BS.1770 and matched in LUFS. EBU R128 and ATSC A/85 use the same algorithm and differ only in target (-23 / -24 LUFS).
tools.loudnessHintpeak: Adjust the sample peak amplitude to the selected dB level.
tools.loudnessHintrms: Mean RMS level is matched in dB. The limiter can protect the output peak.
tools.loudnessHintrms_match_file: Match the mean RMS level of the selected reference file.
tools.loudnessHinttrue_peak: Adjust the measured true peak to the selected dBTP level.
tools.loudnessOutputHint: Output keeps the source extension and adds _loudness. Original files are never overwritten. For files with multiple audio tracks, only the first track is processed.
tools.loudnessTargetNotReached: Some outputs are outside the target level range. Review the measurements and adjust the target, tolerance, or limiter settings.
tools.loudnessTruePeakExceeded: Some outputs exceed the configured true peak limit. Review the measured peaks.
tools.mergeSameDirectory: Input and output directories must be different. Choose another output directory.
tools.midiWarningNoNotes: No valid notes were detected. The generated MIDI contains no playable notes. Check that the input is a clear vocal track.
tools.midiWarningStereoFallback: Stereo downmix phase cancellation was detected. The higher-energy channel was used for transcription.
